lines: That was an empty bottle of a thought.
I have seen old <color:dark_purple>curses</color> with more sense than that.
Careful. Even breath looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken remedies with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
Your spirit has tracked mud across the room.
I have treated fevers with better judgment than yours.
That remark needs washing before it infects anyone else.
You speak like a bad omen trying to sound clever.
Even a cracked bottle holds itself together better.
Your manners need more healing than I have supplies for.
I would pray for your sense, but it should meet me halfway.
You bring unrest like smoke under a door.
That thought arrived limping and refused help.
A bitter potion has more charm than you managed there.
You are not cursed. You are choosing this.
I have heard kinder sounds from a brewing stand running dry.
Your words need a quarantine and a lesson.
That was not honesty. That was carelessness wearing a clean shirt.
Even bad luck seems organized beside you.
